thinker: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one complete, unlettered wide 16:9 painting for an immersive art-directed web scene, ideally 2048x1152. The theme is a classical Thinker studying ONE unbranded silver laptop in an after-hours artist's study. This must have believable sculptural depth and environmental perspective like a coherent museum painting, not an editorial texture wall. Scene: a quiet spacious contemporary stone atelier at dusk. Three large spatial planes only: a dark foreground plinth/desk corner cutting across the very bottom; the seated Thinker and laptop in the near midground on the right; a much more distant smooth slate/petrol-blue room receding into a single tall rectangular recessed opening. The opening is offset far right behind the shoulder, softly lit cool blue from outside, showing only atmosphere, NOT landscape, forest, mountain, palace, sky stars or machinery. A broad raking soft light enters from upper left and reveals the Thinker's brow, chin hand, chest, elbow and stone support with graduated modelling, cast shadow and contact shadow. The quiet left wall and lower floor recede in coherent perspective and remain dark and low-detail for later white Chinese typography, not a blank pale rectangle. Rich but restrained dark navy, slate, cool verdigris-grey, bone-grey highlights and silver. No yellow or gold and no overall purple tone. Statue: dignified, monumental, recognizably Rodin-like thoughtful pose, pale-grey patinated stone with smooth dimensional planes and fine material detail, not a crumbling rough plaster object. Head near x77%, y27%; chin supported by one hand and elbow supported on thigh; other hand naturally operating laptop on lap/stone ledge around x76%,y66%. Exactly two arms/hands, anatomically credible fingers and real laptop hinge and keyboard. Large upper-body crop, right and bottom body exits canvas. Keep the head/chin-hand/laptop action readable. Foreground edge creates occlusion and depth but doesn't cut across face or hand. Material and edges: fine controlled painterly realism, old-master glazing/soft modelling with contemporary precise art direction, realistic directional light; sparse visible brush marks only near form transitions. NOT impasto, trowelled plaster, uniform noise, flat graphic geometry, photoreal object pasted on a background or CGI clay render. Deliberate cinematic asymmetry and foreground/midground/distance hierarchy. Dark x5-47%, y18-84% and top y0-12% should allow independently editable cream-white text later; maintain visual atmosphere without objects or bright edges in that text area. No letters, numbers, titles, UI, buttons, bubbles, borders, logos, watermarks, headset, phone, tablet, holograms, neon, astrology rings, space gadgets, extra characters or clouds. Do not copy any specific existing website artwork.
